notes.title: A Few Words, Straight from the Heart
notes.content:
[h3]Dear friends, Daoist friends,[/h3][p]In the blink of an eye, [i]The Lost Village[/i] has been with you for more than two years. Not too long, not too short—but every step along the way carries your presence.[/p][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/11a46b74a062350c1c9a9a35f9c4ca0d2ed137d7.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Looking Back, Memories Still Fresh[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Jan 15, 2023[/b]: We handed you the EA version—nervous and excited all at once.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mar 31[/b]: the Astrolabe glimmers, new sects rise, and divine beasts emerge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jun 7[/b]: the Trial Tower pierced the skies, bringing Dual Cultivation and the Dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jun 27[/b]: Sect positions, authority, nightmares, and legacy—all making the world richer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aug 2[/b]: Destiny artifacts were born, and the celestial auction began.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aug 25[/b]: the Armory and Mythic Art of Spells added new legends.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sep 30[/b]: the flames of Sect Wars were ignited.[/p][/*][*][p][b]In 2024[/b]: we reached the official launch—an unforgettable night where we couldn’t sleep from excitement.[/p][/*][/list][p]After that came the Bloody Land, World Bosses, Sect Descendants… And our collaborations with [i]Immortal Life[/i], [i]Next Stop Jianghu[/i], House of Legacy, and [u]Ascension[/u], widening the boundaries of the world even further.[/p][p]Looking back, every line of update notes feels like a shared cultivation diary we wrote together. There were times of waiting, times of doubt—but you never let go of [i]The Lost Village[/i]. And we, have never forgotten — each and every one of you.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]The Road Ahead, Never Forgotten[/b][/h3][p]Many players have been asking: “What about the things you promised us before? Why haven’t they shown up yet?” The truth is—we haven’t abandoned the game. We’re sorry it’s taken this long. There were technical hurdles, but also because we’ve been experimenting with new ideas we want to bring into [i]The Lost Village[/i].[/p][p]For example:[/p][list][*][p]We want disciples to be smarter.[/p][/*][*][p]We want more interactive details in the world.[/p][/*][*][p]We want dynamic weather, four seasons, day and night…[/p][/*][/list][p]Our plan is to first test these systems in our new project, [i]Eastern Era[/i]. Once they’re stable, we’ll bring them back to [i]The Lost Village[/i]—bug-free. This includes things you’ve long asked for: new character portraits, new illustrations, Workshop support, and more.[/p][p]In the meantime, here are some issues we’ll be fixing soon:[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed UI texture error for the ability: Shield IV[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect toolbar description for Condense Elixir I recipe[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clipping issue with the skill [b]Spirit Sword Technique[/b] in combat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where skill “[b]SwordDown[/b]” did not take effect in Sect Wars[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typo in tooltip for Royal Court cultivation method[/p][/*][*][p]…and more[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p][b]\[New Additions & Optimizations][/b][/p][olist][*][p]Increased the number of Qi Elixir given at the start[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to increase slots for Bosomfriend and Partner[/p][/*][*][p]Increased total number of task quests to 175[/p][/*][*][p]Improved beginner tutorials[/p][/*][*][p]Strengthened cultivation methods for some schools[/p][/*][/olist][p]…and more

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/0bfe65bf63fdb5c27dbf5a607599dc101eb6e1c4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Through Thorns, [/b]We [b]March On[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Our team is currently sprinting with all our strength on [i]Eastern Era[/i]. Beyond just creating a fun game, we also hope to bring some of the best designs and ideas from this new project back into [i]The Lost Village[/i]. For us, this is both a new challenge and a tougher journey.[/p][p]We remain devoted to the simulation & management genre, and we want to keep pushing boundaries in this direction:[/p][list][*][p]Smarter and more dynamic AI systems[/p][/*][*][p]A wealth of random events[/p][/*][*][p]Real-time weather, with shifting seasons, day and night, sun and storm[/p][/*][*][p]Expansive world exploration, where every rock, tree, and beast is interactive[/p][/*][*][p]Building a truly [i]living, breathing[/i] martial world[/p][/*][*][p]…and much more[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]In the future, we hope these systems—and fresh new content—will also find their way into [i]The Lost Village[/i]! Please look forward to it.[/p][p]From starting a sect from nothing, to clashing and vying for dominance in the martial world, we want to create for you not only an engaging world and intriguing sects, but also a xianxia journey filled with both triumph and sorrow—one that truly feels alive.[/p][p]In just two months, on [b]October 13th[/b], we’ll be joining the [i]Steam Next Fest[/i], where a playable demo of [i]Eastern Era[/i] will be available. We sincerely hope you’ll give it a try, and feel the passion we’ve poured into this new work.[/p][p][/p][h3]Through wind and rain—on October 13th, we’ll be waiting for you at Next Fest.[/h3][h3]

notes.title: New Simulation Game [Eastern Era] Add Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Fellow Adventurers of "The Lost Village,"[/b]

We extend our heartfelt gratitude for your two years of support for "The Lost Village." With deep appreciation, we express our sincere thanks to all adventurers who have accompanied its growth. Your suggestions have helped us improve the game significantly.

However, we will not stop moving forward. We strive to create even better games for you. We have initiated and begun the development of a brand-new sect simulation management game, "Eastern Era."

Here, we solemnly promise: the updates and optimizations for "The Lost Village" have never ceased, nor will they. Every suggestion you provide and every bug you report are treasures to us, and we will carefully examine and improve upon each. In upcoming versions, features such as the much-anticipated Creative Workshop, the equipment system in the Treasure Pavilion, and an automatic quest-taking feature are all being actively arranged.

[b]We sincerely invite you to add our game to your wishlist![/b]

[h3][b]Eastern Era[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446240/_/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3446240/_/][h3][u][b]Add Wishlist Now[/b][/u][/h3][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/a42e5b2504abc0c1dcc1bc563cd488dceb24ecec.png[/img]

[h3]Introduction[/h3]
In this martial arts-themed management simulation game, assume the role of a sect leader. As a member of a declining sect, you must flee with your companions and survive in a desolate world, striving to rejuvenate your sect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/937fb6c561c3ac82f8369a65e504c9fb6da1f3ba.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/72b2f6eebcfc96b3f7969245c40c1170a917e4e3.jpg[/img]
[h3]Flesh and Reality[/h3]

In the desolate yet vibrant primal landscapes, disciples will be challenged by needs such as hunger, sleep, and entertainment. They must also withstand the ever-changing weather and natural disasters, maintaining morale against the elements to avoid breakdowns.

Disciples not yet trained in martial arts must tread carefully, as even a single beast can leave lifelong scars on their bodies.

However, the body is the foundation of martial arts. As disciples master internal skills and techniques, their health and physical strength enhance their martial capabilities. Some extreme individuals in the martial world even replace arms or organs with parts of mythical beasts to seek greater power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/c20467d0a6e3cd7a27b54bc5dd15062a0b714496.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/1ea98f8d02c658a775a1bcdf6c7d5447afd8a062.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/9fb01b16ea450e95169603e59499201d1711b2cd.jpg[/img]
[h3]Understanding Martial Arts[/h3]
The ultimate pursuit of martial arts mastery is the greatest desire for those in the martial world. Each disciple begins their journey by reinforcing their foundation and enduring the arduous process of opening their dantian, before training in coveted internal skills and techniques.

However, mastering martial arts is just the first step; diligent practice forms only the foundation of progress. Advancing on the martial path requires providing disciples with rooms that complement their skills, along with the right elixirs and supportive items for rapid advancement.

Combat is also a crucial aspect of enhancing strength. To truly stand unrivaled in the martial world, one must seek out powerful internal skills for disciples, pair them with appropriate techniques, and equip them with mythical weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/c8340e73417dd4d68e69b899d399c8c9f0d47b2d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/4744c9a0a9e42a21ac9cd7f4509ad58ce9c56b3e.png[/img]
[h3]Building Your Unique Sect[/h3]

Collect resources and study construction, manufacturing, and art to choose a cultivation path that aligns with your sect's development.

Leverage architectural knowledge to build grand halls, lofts, and pavilions, integrating them with disciples' daily life facilities to exhibit your appreciation for Eastern architecture. Ensure thoughtful design of storage spaces to prevent damage to materials under poor conditions and high temperatures. Provide suitable living quarters for disciples to boost their morale.

Of course, don't forget to construct defensive structures such as walls and arrow towers to eliminate greedy bandits and ill-intentioned martial world rogues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/c42a10e6ef3fc5324a23075b3327ada0e905f5e9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Compete or Cooperate[/h3]
Develop independently in the martial world, or seek reliable allies. By engaging with other factions, you can influence events across the martial landscape, gaining advantages in both offense and defense.

You can dispatch disciples to attack other sects' bases and cities, conquering them openly through the prowess of your skilled disciples amidst the bloody turmoil for power. Alternatively, use strategic diplomacy to safeguard your interests, or manipulate other sects from the shadows, watching the chaos unfold with delight.

Whether you choose to become the dominant force in the martial world, a shrewd diplomat, or a mastermind behind the scenes, the choice is yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/69459640242f7339972878ff6afe00210fbdd15e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/c2b3ceb997358b1725e6982d6cd43e79c60f3dda.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update: Offspring Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/574b72e6cf5f29ee86eb9d8762d452969105547d.png[/img]

[b]Dear Players of "The Lost Village",[/b]

Greetings to everyone!

We are delighted to share our update with you, our next major update has been updated, and is released to the full version on Today. 

This update is the long-awaited: [u][b]Offspring System[/b][/u].

In line with our principle of rewarding players and enriching the gaming experience, this update will be directly integrated into the main game, and the [b][u]Offspring System will no longer be released as a DLC but will be updated for free into the main game[/u][/b]. Once the update is available, you can experience it by updating your game.

[u][b]Here's the Offspring System:[/b][/u]

[h3]I. Obtaining Offspring[/h3]
[b]1. Build an Academy[/b]
[list]
[*] Find "Academy" in the research technology tree and unlock it. After building the Academy, the offspring feature will be enabled.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/f8b0b2bc3fdf4c374e44647ee751b919ad02ab8b.png[/img]

[b]2. Pregnancy[/b]
[list]
[*] After dual cultivating with partner, there is a high chance for the female to become pregnant.
[*] Disciples may develop feelings for each other, with a certain chance for the female to become pregnant.
[*] Once pregnant, the female will inform the sect leader through a message.
[*] During pregnancy, the female cannot participate in work or battles.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/e99e4c0c2b6f7a811d75c87b883cc2cd94125c91.png[/img]

[h3]II. Offspring Training[/h3]
[b]1. Innate Talent[/b]
[list]
[*] Talent Rating (represents the potential range of attainable cultivation quality): From UR to Normal
[*] An offspring's initial talent rating is mainly determined by their parents' cultivation quality, with a minor influence from their initial potential.
[/list]

[b]2. Potential[/b]
[list]
[*] Potential Rating (represents the current level of potential): Excellent > Above Average > Average > Below Average > Poor
[*] Offspring will initially possess some potential, but most will be rated as Poor.
[*] Potential will influence the life choices available to the offspring, which will shape their growth direction.
[*] Potential will be directly inherited after the offspring reaches adulthood.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/7844917d60af7c5f13c75b9ec1994a635a5c7f95.png[/img]

[b]3. Personality Cultivation[/b]
[list]
[*] Personalities are divided into three main categories: Valiant, Agile, and Steady, each containing several different personality types.
[*] An offspring's initial personality is randomly generated and will be reflected in their overall evaluation description.
[*] The three personality types are mutually exclusive; as one type is cultivated and becomes more prominent, the other two types will be suppressed.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/c27e2f91a5e26ef63418e9f51a40cd0346562b8c.png[/img]

[b]4. Trait Cultivation[/b]
[list]
[*] You can assign a master to the offspring, and upon being accepted as a disciple of the sect after reaching adulthood, they will randomly inherit one trait from their master.
[*] You can cultivate up to 4 trait specializations simultaneously, but they can only be obtained after their respective progress bars are at least partially filled.
[*] Studying different types of trait cultivation manuals will increase the corresponding trait specialization that is currently being cultivated.
[/list]

[h3]III. Family Tree[/h3]
[list]
[*] The offspring interface will display the parents, siblings, and other relatives directly related to the character.
[*] The disciple log will show the character's ancestors, parents, spouse, siblings, and children.
[*] If a family member's portrait is grayed out in the family tree, it indicates that they have passed away.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/6e413c2839bf728befed2d223b33b79252594344.png[/img]

[h3]IV. Taoist Body[/h3]
[list]
[*] Initially, three Red Taoist Body will be available, representing the highest-level realms. In subsequent updates, we will gradually introduce new red super traits, techniques, and realms.
[*] Currently, Red Taoist Body realms can only be obtained through offspring.
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------

[b]The above covers the content of this feature update. Additionally, the plans for the next major update have been finalized. Once the Offspring System update is complete, we will provide a real-time preview.[/b]

notes.title: The Lost Village Full Verison 1.0 Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/43009c521cf1226f6369c99e3117bb808a0fb875.png[/img]

[h3]Dear fellow cultivators of "The Lost Village," greetings![/h3]

After a year of continuous updates, Fuuyoo Games is thrilled to announce the release of the official 1.0 version of indie game "The Lost Village".

Throughout its development, the game has gone through dozens of updates, significantly expanding in content and enhancing gameplay.

[u]To show our appreciation for your support, we're launching at the original price with a -20% discount. One month later, the base price will adjust +10%.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/97d799421bb650d5cc35cefa9f3e549cc075d37b.png[/img]
[h3]- Manage Sect[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the game, players step into the shoes of a sect master returning home, tasked with leading their cultivation sect from scratch towards a grand revival. Challenge yourself, conquer the mythic worlds, and ultimately attain enlightenment.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/be566464f43a434ec6f2abc3f966a26d0d349af5.png[/img]
[h3]- Manage Disciples[/h3]
[list]
[*] You'll begin by recruiting powerful disciples, having them engage in various chores and tasks from the most basic resource gathering. 

[*] Gradually, you'll instruct them in cultivating spiritual fields, concocting elixirs, refining techniques, and growing alongside you, their sect master.

[*] Once disciples reach the Foundation Realm, they will obtain their personal Destiny Artifact. They must refine these artifacts to gain significant improvements. Thus, you'll need to organize the sect's store, allowing disciples to exchange for what they need.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/9c205f433f55ed208ec0c276549a3afa8e98bed9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/422b6de6764b51130aadc8f20b65c30dda40944c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/778acaf7b04dac31759b8c21987ba7c1be488555.png[/img]
[list][*] You can promote your disciples, assign them to positions and tasks, and willingly serve your cause. You can establish policies for your sect, steering its growth in a direction you favor.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/6f7e2a1b0155b4006d18e5be91383ef1e13587e8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/b44a5d8e6e3d8d12e7993faf3994a52966cd671b.png[/img]
[h3]- Dual Cultivation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Additionally, you can form a bond with favored disciples, practicing dual cultivation, and eventually becoming life partners. The upcoming progeny system will add depth to the sect's development and revitalization, ensuring its legacy continues indefinitely.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/13175f4b5c58f9dc195ce69bae0ee84c75a270ba.png[/img]
[h3]- Illusion Realm Challenge[/h3]
[list]
[*] Advancing your sect's development requires various resources from different realms. Enter diverse illusionary domains, secret realms, to secure resources. Venture into the Tower of Demons and Gods, the Arcane Lights Illusion, and the Cangwu Abyss to solidify your advantage.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/914e9ee18f71fade02888f076a8b51575ce2a013.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/efbbf87e5ddc89648bcc9b577acb29c261907928.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/cae9851d4f80cb6bc04a2ffa8eedd4429325284d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Dispatch disciples to the Bloody Land, Trial Tower for competitive encounters, not only facing formidable illusionary bosses but also vying with other sects for resources across the outer world.
[/list]
[h3]- Conquer the Outer World[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lastly, there's always the option to defeat them all, conquer the entire mythic world, and unify the land under your banner.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/95dfde93aefe54fbba8263733bad7d9db0d20bd8.png[/img]

[h3]- Ascension[/h3]
[list]
[*] Once all tasks are completed, you can arrange for ascension and transcendence, allowing your disciples to guard and escort you to the immortal realms, leaving behind your legendary legacy.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/bb7c5b58efcc86f455181b237631115fd809f3db.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3]Game-related Questions[/h3]

[h3]1. Feeling the game is hard to get into at the beginning?[/h3]

Yes, we’ve been continuously optimizing the experience for newcomers to the game. It's true that the beginning has many concepts and content to familiarize with. However, the game is designed to be relatively stress-free, without overwhelming external pressures or survival challenges. Players can take their time to leisurely enjoy and gradually understand its systems. As you accumulate achievement points (Taoist Point), starting new saves will become smoother.

Should you have any questions, feel free to join our community group or Discord. There, you can interact and exchange tips with fellow adventurous players. We believe the game's later stages will not disappoint you.

[h3]2. How do I obtain certain items?[/h3]

We apologize for not providing an item encyclopedia. Thanks to the enthusiastic players during the Early Access period, a WIKI has been compiled, which you can check at [u]https://wiki.biligame.com/thelostvillage/[/u] for item information(Sorry Only Chinese), with updates by players from time to time. We would love for you to contribute to it as well. However, we recommend exploring on your own for unexpected delights.

[h3]3. I've encountered a BUG, what should I do?[/h3]

We are sorry that your gaming experience was slightly marred. We are committed to continuous updates and optimizations, as we have been doing for the past year. You can join our Discord group or contact us via email. We will address it as soon as possible.

[h3]4. Any plans for future updates?[/h3]

Certainly. The game has gradually moved beyond just the creators working in isolation, with much of the content now being co-created between players and developers. Features like [u]Sect Wars, Dual Cultivation, Sect Policies[/u], etc., were developed based on feedback from players. So, updates will continue.

We plan to release several early free DLCs, followed by paid ones, and we hope players will return to explore these additions. 

After launch, we may make frequent small optimizations and adjustments based on player feedback, which might lead to regular game patches on Steam. We appreciate your patience and understanding.
--------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]We deeply appreciate all the support from our players. Rest assured, we are committed to continuously updating and making our game even better.[/h2]

notes.title: Full Release Trailer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/8555842063faf843902c4771250c758b376cbc15.png[/img]

[b]Dear The Lost Village players, happy weekend! [/b]

We're excited to announce that after continuous updates for 1 year and 3 months and many major and minor version updates, our game will officially launch on [b]April 8, 2024 (CST)[/b]. Thanks for your support over the year. 

The launch price will increase by [b]10%[/b], but there will be an initial discount, so stay tuned. 

At launch, we'll gift a free DLC [b]"Sect Heirs"[/b], allowing players to cultivate successors. This DLC will be released within half a month after launch and will be free for one month. 

[u]Post-launch, we will produce at least three more DLCs, which will be free for the first month after release.[/u]

[h2]· New Gameplay[/h2]
[h3]I. Sect Tournament[/h3] 
[list] 
[*] Every so often, the cultivation world holds a grand tournament to witness the strength of capable disciples. Assign your followers to compete in this event against disciples from other sects.
[*] Prepare them with suitable skills, destiny artifact, etc., to face the challenge. Victorious disciples will earn substantial rewards and become more loyal to you. [b]【Sorry For the untranslated image】[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/dc261b5e9a7d3462b0c23efcd26c217c03c7dfe9.png[/img]
[h3]II. Master Ascension[/h3]
[list] 
[*] The Sect Master has reached the Ascension X realm and will ascend to the immortal realms. He/She must endure divine punishment for defying the heavens. Arrange for disciples to protect him against the powerful thunder tribulation to achieve ascension.
[*] The Elder Hall will be updated post-ascension, providing permanent buffs and protection to the sect.
[*] After ascension, a new Sect Master will be appointed who can continue to provide protection after their ascension.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/24069add836d8301c9452a3cebdaa5119a6cb06d.png[/img]
[h3]III. Sect Policy[/h3]
[list] 
[*] Players can create unique policies for their sect, affecting disciples’ productivity, combat efficiency, and disciples' mood.
[*] Regularly issue policies tailored to the sect’s developmental stage, like production-boosting policies for the early phase and combat/training encouragement policies for later stages.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Landscape System[/h3]
[list]
[*] The current landscaping lacks variety and benefits, which does not meet the ever-expanding management needs of players. We will enable interactions between landscapes, where placing certain buildings together may produce special effects, beyond just being visually appealing.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/b16a57413a40342ba5009470ca76f2cfca3fd995.png[/img]
[h3]V. Free DLC - Heirs System (Post-Launch Update)[/h3]
[list]
[*] After dual cultivation between sect master and disciples or among disciples, there's a chance to produce offspring;
[*] Players must raise these offspring until they reach adulthood, after which they join the sect;
[*] Players need to cultivate disciples' Elemental Roots, which ultimately could result in offspring growing up with different abilities;
[*] Offspring may encounter unique adventures, bringing new experiences to themselves and the sect;
[*] Offspring could develop a new [b]Red Taoist Body[/b], becoming extremely powerful fighters.
[/list]

[h2]· New Content[/h2]
[h3]I. New Homestead: Kun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new homestead where players can build a sect on the back of a Kun[u](An ancient Chinese mythical creature, a whale that can fly and burrow, very huge)[/u]. Unlocked by Taoist Point after starting a new game. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/5abefaba5b6d6c3dda927378b1c7e0e4e0d2fb69.png[/img]
[h3]II. Demonic Relic/Demon Lair[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weakened the previous lengthy illusion gameplay, added faster and more thrilling illusions, referencing Bloody Land. This meets the player's demand to either grind or farm at will, reducing the pressure to play long illusions.
[*] Both game modes also follow the treasure-hunting model, taking reference from Bloody Land, so stay tuned.
[/list]
[h3]III. Two New Demonic Bosses[/h3]
[list]
[*] Having just one Spider Queen seems too monotonous, so we will add some new world bosses for players to tease and enjoy.
[/list]
[h3]IV. New Additions: Weapons, Taoist Body, Skills, Dual Cultivation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added several orange-grade weapons (Great Axe, Longsword, Talismans)
[*] Added several orange-grade Taoist Bodies (Specialized in Talismans and Heavy Sword)
[*] Added 12 individual skills
[*] Added 5 orange-grade destiny artifact, which require essence souls to forge
[*] Added 4 new dual cultivation techniques
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/ced2bf81c22be9744078bc1999b155001c5f399e.jpg[/img]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]· Q&A on the Full Release[/h2]  
[h3]1. Why release the Full version? Is the game complete?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] The game currently has 3 different illusion realms, sect wars, Sect Tournament, and Master Ascensions, making up a full set of content. We believe it meets the basic requirements of a complete game, hence the full release.  

[*] However, this does not mean the game is perfect. Like Warcraft III receiving balance patches 20 years after release, we see game optimization as endless. We'll keep optimizing and updating!  

[*] The full release doesn’t mean stopping; it's a declaration to our team and players, moving the game into a new phase!  
[/list]  
[h3]2. What's the difference between the full version and EA?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] The full version offers a complete game experience, unlike EA’s experimental features. It's more systematic and structured, adding much more gameplay.  

[*] For players with hundreds of hours in EA, the new content might not seem extensive, but as mentioned, we're continuously updating, including free DLCs to enrich the game.  
[/list]  
[h3]3. Do players who bought the EA version need to buy it again?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] After the full release, all players who bought the EA version can update to the full version for free, with no extra cost or purchase needed.  
[/list]  
[h3]4. What are your plans for future updates?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] We'll keep optimizing for bugs, functionality, and regularly release free DLCs to reward all players. We'll continue to try new things we find interesting, like the Steam Workshop.  
[/list]  
[h3]5. Can EA version saves be carried over?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Yes. You can continue playing your existing saves. However, to experience new DLC content in the future, you’ll need to start a new save.  
[/list] 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3]We look forward to the official release meeting you and hope you can support our small game development team.[/h3]

notes.title: First 2024 Major Update Released
notes.content:
Greetings to all "[b]The Lost Village[/b]" players, and Happy New Year! We appreciate your support over the past year. We have now launched our first update of 2024. The new version has been updated, and we invite everyone to experience it. Below are the update details.

[h3]I. Changes to the entry of the Illusion Realm[/h3]

Considering the previous complaints about the "Boring" in the Illusion Realm, we've integrated some random open-world elements. Thus, the entry to the Illusion Realm is now discovered through [b]【Detecting】[/b] on the [b]【Out World】[/b].

[b]The purposes of these changes are as follows:[/b]
[olist]
[*] It facilitates the expansion of our future Illusion Realm levels. We have many more Illusion Realm gameplay styles planned which the original entry point could not accommodate.
[*] We have significantly increased output from adventure and planting, so players don't have to constantly grind in the Illusion Realm. This addresses complaints about the game being too monotonous, turning the Illusion Realm into a semi-linear + semi-open play style without a compulsory resource grind.
[*] Some levels with resources will always be available for players to even out resource collection.
[*] This adds more experiences and interaction to the Out World, instead of simply idling, thus enhancing the depth of the game.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/d77fbc1f6baeecda80c86ecb7407a8a41b33026e.png[/img]

[h3]II. Added the Bloody Land[/h3]

In response to previous player feedback about the Out World being too [b]lonely[/b] and the desire for more interaction, we proactively introduced a new treasure hunting mode. In this mode, players will compete with disciples from other sects for the treasures in the  Bloody Land. This is designed to simulate the setting where various sects in cultivation novels scramble for treasures, aiming to enhance your gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/7b5460e748dcfbf126b297102b6050b53cc06088.jpg[/img]

[h3]III. Demonic Boss[/h3]

A timed Demonic Boss level has been added for players to continuously challenge themselves and gather resources. In future, a points system will be added to allow players to compete with forces from other sects and validate their abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/7d8b4825f7a047c3ffc94a4d5961b32f20f8db42.jpg[/img]

[h3]IV. Personalized Breakthroughs[/h3]

We've added lower, middle, and upper class breakthroughs to create a wider gap in disciple strength, making supporting disciples more powerful. This means disciples that players cannot pay much attention to won't need to consume too many sect resources.

At the same time, we will soon update the [b]Rebirth System[/b]. This allows players a second chance if they make a mistake during the breakthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/08b094e795c36a96db786169c535ab867bae9c15.png[/img]

[h3]V. Other Optimization[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Optimized the main UI to be more clear and beautiful.
[*] We've improved the introduction for new players (updated recently) to help them better understand the roles and connections of each gameplay aspect.
[*] Enhanced the World Map's representation to make it more lively.
[*] Optimized the foreign affairs hall orders and raiding harvest, which can be improved by running a sect and maintaining good relationships with other sects.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/cc06d591167d67a7bcc5ef05e86edefa4f846aec.jpg[/img]

----------------------------------------
[h3]Here are some previews and ideas for the next version[/h3]

[h3]I. Scenery System[/h3]

Currently, the strategy aspect is lacking in the home scenery creation and visits. We hope to create combinations of scenery and buildings to make the placement of buildings in the home more strategic. For example, the Bamboo and the Master Statue could potentially interact with each other in special ways.

[h3]II. Elder Hall[/h3]

Many players have expressed their wish to switch the sect master without starting from scratch. We plan to introduce an Elder Hall, which allows the current leader to ascend to the immortal world after reaching a certain realm, providing protection for the sect. At the same time, you can appoint previous disciples as the head of the sect, ensuring the continued existence of your sect.

PS: You might be able to ascend several leaders. Therefore, there might be many former leaders present in the hall...

[h3]III. More World Bosses and Illusion Levels[/h3]

Currently, we only have the Spider Queen. We plan to introduce more Demonic Bosses and additional Illusion levels to ensure that your large map never feels lonely.

To give some spoilers, a new Sect map, [b]Kun[/b], is under development, which will allow players to construct their homes on the body of a moving giant beast.

------------------------------------------
Finally, thank you all for your valuable input! We are trying our best to listen to your suggestions and continuously update. If you have any questions or thoughts to share, feel free to join our Discord. Your input is greatly appreciated!

notes.title: Update Preview December
notes.content:
[b]Dear fans of The Lost Village players,[/b]

[b]Merry Christmas and Happy New Year in advance! [/b]The last update, which included Sect Wars, enriched the gaming experience, but we know there's still room for improvement. So, over the past month, we've been adding more gameplay features, fixing bugs, and adjusting values. We expect to complete the version update within half a month. Stay tuned for the update details!

[i][Due to the substantial amount of development, the English translation for this update may be incomplete. We will update it as soon as possible!][/i]

[h3]I. Forbidden Trials[/h3] 

Updated multiple instances of sect combat where you'll compete alongside other factions to defeat the guardian BOSS and earn substantial rewards! The game includes four different types of Forbidden Trials: the melee-focused "Bloody Lands", "Ancient Relics", and solo challenges like " Immortal Cave" await your exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/7b5460e748dcfbf126b297102b6050b53cc06088.jpg[/img]

[h3]II. New Demonic Boss Challenges[/h3] 

Periodically, powerful demonic bosses will spawn on the world map invading the world, which might be unbeatable. However, by enduring the bosses' trials, you will earn a wealth of rare materials. Organize your disciples effectively to maximize damage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/7d8b4825f7a047c3ffc94a4d5961b32f20f8db42.jpg[/img]
[h3]III. Illusion Realm Gameplay Redesign[/h3] 
[b]1. Farm in Peace[/b] 
[list] 
[*] We've redesigned the Illusion Realm and Trial Tower entrance after hearing complaints about its patchwork nature. We've introduced a variety of random events and scattered them throughout the world map. You're no longer confined to just completing levels; you can send disciples to explore, or lead the exploration yourself, allowing you to farm in peace.
[/list] 
[b]2. Revamped Rewards[/b] 
[list] 
[*] We have revamped the reward system. Depending on the difficulty of the Illusion Realm, you'll not only receive different rewards but also gain reputation points, which can be exchanged for essential resources for your sect development, significantly improving the weaker early Illusion Realm positive feedback experience.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/ced2bf81c22be9744078bc1999b155001c5f399e.jpg[/img]

[h3]IV. Overhaul of the Breakthrough System[/h3]

[b]1. Breakthrough Quality[/b]

Breakthroughs now let disciples choose the result, such as top-grade, mid-grade, or low-grade when forming their core, allowing for more precise planning of a disciple's development path.

[b]2. Disciple Rebirth[/b]

A new feature has been added for the rebirth of disciples, aiding those who have reached the Ascension to reselect their breakthrough path, eliminating the fear of not being able to perfectly cultivate a disciple.

notes.title: July End Version Preview --- Dating, Auction & Letter system
notes.content:
[b][h3]Dear, players,
[/h3][/b]
After the update of the Trial Tower, we have received feedback from many enthusiastic players. While ensuring the stability of the current version, we have already started the development of the next version. We have updated the development roadmap on our homepage, and we welcome everyone to view it at any time. Next, we will preview the update content for the coming month.

[b]PS: The game interface images below haven't been translated into English yet. Please understand.[/b]

[h3]1. Position Optimization[/h3]
We never want players to act as nannies. The sect will have more focused positions, and players can fine-tune the exchange situations of each position.

Elders will also patrol the sect premises, and wherever they go, the disciples being inspected will work more proactively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/47f000117c341fe33bb89afa9dfccc5c3058b2ad.png[/img]
[h3]2. Trial Nightmare[/h3]
Since the launch of the Trial Tower, players have reported low challenges. Therefore, while keeping the main storyline difficulty unchanged, we will offer [u][b]more difficulty options[/b][/u] for higher-level players, allowing them to combine their own challenges and strive for their first-blood miracle. At the same time, the rewards will be more abundant, with rare Form-eyes and legendary equipment obtainable in higher difficulties.

Of course, we will also introduce many new skills for the Trial Tower, creating more combinations and matching possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/98b367f9951da36a82f03bf148baaef87c0c468c.png[/img]
[h3]3. Letter System[/h3]
Disciples often seem like mere workers and lack vitality. We hope that disciples can occasionally visit their hometowns to bring back some local specialties and maintain warm relationships with the sect master. Therefore, we have added a letter system, aiming to encourage casual conversations between the disciples and the sect master.

[h3]4. Auction[/h3]
Many players have reported a shortage of spirit stones, while some have an abundance of materials like wood, or are unable to obtain a particular martial arts. As a result, we have introduced an auction house, hoping to help players interact with strangers from the martial world, allowing for a more balanced and abundant supply of materials within their sects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/76ef7b2031787a6448de9c6878b91585fb117456.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/f69fe809b40340cccecb9c7a36d6e2cc8a8202bb.png[/img]
[h3]5. Dating and Passing on[/h3]
Giving gifts to partners within the sect makes it seem too money-oriented. In the new version, the sect master can enjoy sightseeing and appreciate the beauty of flowers with partners, enhancing their relationship. For relatively weak ordinary disciples, the master can pass on their skills to help them improve their realm as quickly as possible.

By the way, we will also introduce more dual cultivation techniques, allowing you to create your powerful combination of martial arts with your partner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/951ad28307843b7adc7fffbc935fa00b310041fc.png[/img]
[h3]----------The following content cannot be guaranteed to be updated----------[/h3]

[h3]1. Armor Pavilion[/h3]
We are finally introducing the long-awaited weapon equipment system. Players can obtain weapons of different qualities through the Trial Tower. You can forge, refine, and enhance these weapons to gain greater abilities, which will help you in your Illusory Realm expeditions. However, as this feature might require a substantial amount of content, we are not certain whether it will be updated in the next version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/ac675cd2e126d6b7edc672698dd4bf9e866a1a7c.jpg[/img]
[h3]2. Destiny Artifact[/h3]
Players have mentioned that disciples seem like mere workers, with some spending their entire lives chopping wood or mining stone. Additionally, their characteristics on the battlefield do not appear very distinct. We will assign a destiny artifact to each disciple, which they will refine in their spare time, developing their unique attributes.
[list]
[*] They may have a Talisman as their destiny artifact, becoming a ranged AOE cultivator.
[*] They may have a Hammer as their destiny artifact, turning into a highly resilient "Tank".
[*] ...
[/list]

[h3]3. Optimizations[/h3]
[olist]
[*] We have identified and prioritized the following optimizations:
[*] Warehouse and inventory sorting system
[*] Balancing of faith store points
[*] Balancing the difficulty levels in the Trial Tower along with increasing the variety of monsters
[*] Adding more Formation Eyes
[*] Reducing the black screen time during startup
[*] ...
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/72506b1047b7a232230cb5e04754a75a692331ae.png[/img]
[h3]Stay tuned and look forward to our updates![/h3]

notes.title: English Version Update!
notes.content:
Dear "The Lost Village" players, long time no see! After our development team's around-the-clock efforts, we have finally updated the [b]English version[/b] of the game, along with updates to the "Trial Tower," "dungeon," and "Karmamudrā" modes (also known as Dual Cultivation mode).

We sincerely apologize for the delay in updating the [b]English version[/b]. All translations were done by our own production team, and we are well aware that many of our translation efforts may have flaws. If you encounter any issues, please leave a comment to let us know.

Now, let's take a look at the new game content in this June update.

[h2]一、🗼Trial Tower[/h2]

Some players have been expressing that our battles are not thrilling and satisfying enough, and we certainly understand what kind of experience the world of cultivation should offer. Therefore, we spent over a month creating the "Trial Tower" mode. Players can control their own disciples, gradually improve themselves in the illusion world within the tower, face beast waves, establish their own Building combinations, and survive in this [b]Survivor mode.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/98b367f9951da36a82f03bf148baaef87c0c468c.png[/img]

In this illusion realm, players will gain experience and level up by defeating a certain number of demon beasts, which will grant passive bonuses. The demon beasts will also drop varying amounts of spirit stones, which can be used to enhance your active skills or learn new ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/7ef5173adc5a2a780b0c99a3e94769b73a340b38.png[/img]

Different skills may undergo skill fusion. When you have discovered and upgraded all compatible skills to their highest level, you can synthesize a super skill, which will enable you to dominate the battlefield.

[b]OUR FEATURE[/b]: You can send up to [b]3[/b] disciples to participate in the trial at the same time. By upgrading their divine powers, they can even ride[b] clouds and fog[/b] or fly with swords!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/5b314f4ce8a5d9472bbe29a9cc0e34e33801af9d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/20e3e0df6110f9fbaf424fb52f82f3cca3b8cb73.png[/img]

Before entering the Trial Tower, you need to choose your own formation and the formation flags, which will be updated in the future. Different formations come with varying skill sets. Once you select a formation and enter the Immortal and Demon Tower, you'll be presented with different upgrade paths, ensuring a unique gaming experience in every round.

[b]It's like we have created a whole new game... 🤣🤣[/b]

[h2]二、🦇Dungeons[/h2]

On a default path, players need to actively choose the monsters they encounter in each room, considering their own astrological path, and ultimately face the inevitable final BOSS.

Can you become powerful enough within the limited turns to challenge the final BOSS? Test your strategy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/088cb0e5f62a27b744b19894f932e70ca7e67a59.png[/img]

[h2]三、💕Karmamudrā(Dual Cultivation)[/h2]

You need to properly manage the relationships between you and your disciples. They all have different personalities; some may harbor resentment towards you due to their extreme nature, while others are friendly and require minimal management to remain loyal. You can give them gifts to increase their affection for you. Once their affection is high enough, they might even send you specialties from their hometown (in the next version).

Of course, different disciples have different preferences: some enjoy wielding swords and dancing with blades, while others appreciate a red bellyband.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/951ad28307843b7adc7fffbc935fa00b310041fc.png[/img]

When your relationship with them reaches a certain level, you can form a sibling bond with same-sex disciples and pass your Traits to them. With opposite-sex disciples, you can practice Karmamudrā cultivation (a martial art that cultivates strength by men and women together), which can grant you one of their Traits. This way, both parties can benefit from strengthening their abilities and shared traits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/203605a29e60b1845baf7e4a81e3d371f1e442f2.png[/img]

Of course, you can also choose to cut off your relationship with them. Heartbroken and devastated, they might leave your sect for good, and there may be no turning back...

[h2]IV. ℹ️ Some Optimizations[/h2]

[h3]1. Display Optimization[/h3]

The latest FSR optimization has been updated. Players can now adjust the quality and performance modes based on their graphics card conditions, significantly reducing graphics card usage and improving image quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/d107d257d7e4bb66a273c3738f34e232bcd2e2dd.png[/img]

[b]However, only the following graphics card models are supported:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/9a774fc4213d224b1537f5793311eaa28dc1ee0e.png[/img]

[h3]2. Other Optimizations[/h3]

[list]
[*] Optimized some explosive sound effects and added rich ambient sounds to all home locations, enhancing immersion;
[*] Added English translations, allowing players who enjoy learning foreign languages to switch to the English version;
[*] Optimized a lot of text descriptions, aiming for simple and clear communication;
[*] Improved the newbie tutorial, ensuring that new players no longer feel confused when entering the game.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/1ffeb2e7e6a44c329004851117efd91f398919af.png[/img]

The above is the update announcement for this version. We hope everyone enjoys playing and provides us with more feedback!

[b]The next version is already under planning. What will it be? Please stay tuned![/b]

[h2]Hey gamers! [/h2]

[b]Good news[/b]: We've released some May update content early for you to try out.

Featured in this update: Marriage Mode, Dungeon Mode & Trial Tower Mode, Formation gameplay, and the Immortal Auction among other improvements.

We've fixed numerous bugs causing crashes in both the Home and Illusionary worlds, addressing issues like lag and optimizing health bar displays and item pickup ranges.

notes.title: March Update Plan（March 31 Release）
notes.content:
Hello dear players,  "The Lost Village" hasn't been updated for a long time since we don't have English Version . The game has been released for more than a month in Chinese Verison, and we have received a lot of good feedback, and many players have given us countless pertinent opinions. While fixing some bugs and adding some new bugs🤨, we are preparing for a major update in March , including English Version. Since we are still developing some content and assessing the risk of going online, we divide it into two parts to report.

[h2]1. New Content (top)[/h2]

[b][h3]1, 👯Multi New Game+ system[/h3][/b]
In the past month, many friends have cleared the level and reached the highest level of "Ascension" 💯, and they all come to inquire about the unlocking conditions of the new game. 

[*]🗺[b]New map[/b]
Some players complained that the current map is not enough, not big enough, other sects may be bigger and more domineering;

[*]🎮[b]New level[/b]
There are currently six levels in the first game, and each level has different tasks and goals. Each of the other sects will also have different checkpoints, and the playing methods are different;

[*]📝[b]New plot[/b]
Different sects have their own independent plots;

[*]🚀[b]New Technology[/b]
Different sects have different characteristics, so the corresponding technology unlocking methods will also be slightly different;

[*]💑[b]New Taoism, characteristics and disciples[/b]
Different sects may recruit disciples, Taoism, and characteristics are different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/e05b506f39f8a09159ea60e5d9a30732fce387f9.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]2, 🐉Sacred Beast System[/h3][/b]
With the game system, our mythical beast gameplay is about to come out. Different sects, of course, have different villages and mythical beasts to provide a unique experience. It can assist the development of your sect, it can improve the potential of your disciples, and it can enter the illusion battle with you.

[*]🍔[b]Feeding the beast[/b]
Let your animal grow by feeding it, and improve its combat ability and various attributes;

[*]💆‍♂️[b]Teach and bless[/b]
Divine beasts can improve the attributes of your disciples, give them potential, and make them stronger🏋️‍♂️;

[*]🐉[b]Sacred Beast[/b]
The beast can enter the battle with the player, exert its powerful power of the beast, and fight side by side with you, and the more you fight, the braver it becomes ⚔️.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658040/fa2ed536c57bea0b618c91c111f7a719f091812f.png[/img]

[h3]3. 🧘‍♀️Tao body characteristics[/h3]
Many players said, how can I feel that there is no difference between me, a disciple of the Nascent Soul Stage 🏋️, and a disciple of the Foundation Establishment Stage 🤸‍♀️? Yes, that's right, the value of roguelike games may not be the same as some RPG games, but we now have a new Taoist system, so that the difference in the realm of the disciples will be more obvious.

Different dao bodies can acquire many different combat characteristics in a special period after breaking through the catastrophe. For example, some can be revived, some can be cloned, some can summon flying swords, and some may just...cut trees faster?

Therefore, different Taoist bodies, after the realm is improved, although they will not get a particularly large attribute improvement, and will not kill the little sheep in the tribulation period, they will still get a unique experience🧗‍♀️.

[h2]Game Optimization (on)[/h2]

[b][h3]1. 🏗Industrial Chain Reconstruction[/h3][/b]
Due to constant adjustments and new additions during the game development period, the consumption and output of our previous industrial chain no longer match the game process, resulting in some output being pitiful, and some not being used. So we reorganized all the inputs and outputs, and strived to adjust them to be more reasonable and balanced, which is more in line with the feeling of a SLG game.

[b][h3]2, 🙅 Anti-Human Design[/h3][/b]
At present, there are still some relatively mentally handicapped settings in the game. For example, if the fantasy challenge fails, there will always be a "Rookie" debuff... For example, there is no clear label for the shortcut key... For example,... Let's not talk about it , It's hard to say.

[h2]3. Experience and Stability Improvements[/h2]

[b][h3]1, ⁉️Optimize flashback[/h3][/b]
This is nothing to say, the eternal fatal error of Unreal Engine is our lifelong enemy!

[b][h3]2, 🖥GPU optimization[/h3][/b]
Many players complain that the GPU fan spins faster. We think that apart from the main problem of players not having a GTX 4090 LOL~~, the game can also be optimized. Therefore, we have carried out a series of optimization actions to try to keep the fan from spinning so fast.

Of course, game optimization is a continuous work, we will not stop optimizing the game until both Pentium 4 and GTX 660 can... open the game.

-------------------------------------------------- -----------------

Thank you for reading this, the above is the first half of the updated and optimized content of our March version.

There may be some game settings in the early stage that make players feel a little uncomfortable and awkward. We will sincerely accept everyone's suggestions and optimize it slowly. Thank you for your support.

🎺[u] In the second half, we will announce the player's operable content, disciple contribution system, etc. Please look forward to it. [/u]
